text: {"lessons":["My account rose substantially overall, but its ups and downs remind me that monthly results alone do not reveal what prices will do next.","Selling Stock D after a large gain and buying other stocks changed my allocation; I should make such trades only when they fit my risk and diversification plan, not simply to realize a gain.","I made no trades in most periods, which helped me avoid reacting to noise; I should keep checking that my portfolio suits my goals without letting frequent monitoring trigger unnecessary trades."]}
